research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: XGenomes is engaged in developing DNA sequencing technologies focused on detecting epigenetic modifications. The work described in 'Random Epigenomic Sampling' involves methods and systems for determining disease presence by sequencing and analyzing the modification state, such as methylation, across random genomic loci. 'Systems, methods, and compositions for detecting epigenetic modifications' details approaches for identifying nucleic acid modifications using probes to detect signal differences. These efforts center on advanced epigenomic analysis.

overview_description.description: XGenomes is a developer of DNA sequencing technologies. Their platform is accessible throughout an individual’s lifetime taking base-lines pre and post-birth, monitoring health, picking up early signals of disease, and tracking the effect of interventions.
